metadata.title: Security-Grade Coverage in the Agent Skills Hub Catalog: June 2026 Snapshot (105,000+ Entries) and November 2026 Count
metadata.description:
What changed in this version (version 2, 21 November 2026). Version 1 gave "105,000+ indexed skills" and "97.8% never security-audited" without a date. They describe the Agent Skills Hub catalog around 10 June 2026, when the original post was written; this version dates them and adds the catalog count of 21 November 2026 as a separate row. Version 1 also called the 2,300+ graded entries a "5-dimension supply-chain audit"; they were the entries that had a security grade in the catalog at the time, and the five dimensions are a checklist the author used to review 200+ repositories by hand, which this record does not cover. Version 1's counts per group (102,690 / 2,171 / 129) had been worked back from rounded percentages and are removed.

Agent Skills Hub (agentskillshub.top) indexes open-source AI agent skills, MCP servers and Codex skills from GitHub and gives some of them a security grade (safe, caution, unsafe, reject). Around 10 June 2026 the catalog held 105,000+ entries; 97.8% had no security grade, 2.1% were graded safe and 0.1% caution, unsafe or reject. Of the 2,300+ graded entries, 94% were safe and about 5.6% caution, unsafe or reject. These figures were read from the catalog database for a post dated 10 June 2026; the exact time was not recorded.

On 21 November 2026 the catalog listed 281,000+ entries, 142,000+ of them with a rule-based security grade (agentskillshub.top/llms.txt). The share of graded entries rose because the Hub extended its grading, so the two dates are not a trend in the ecosystem. Per-entry grades for 130,173 entries (6 July 2026) are in a separate dataset, 10.5281/zenodo.21292799. The author founded Agent Skills Hub.
